title: Stratified Sparse Attention: Reducing the Sparse-to-Dense Gap at Extreme Sparsity
abstract: arXiv:2610.28441v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large Language Model inference over long contexts is increasingly bottlenecked by the cost of attending to a growing Key-Value (KV) cache. Sparse attention reduces this cost by accessing only a fraction of the cache, but existing methods face a trade-off between deterministic retrieval, which captures high-scoring tokens but discards residual attention mass, and sampling, which improves coverage at the cost of higher variance. Hybrid methods combine top-$k$ retrieval with uniform sampling, yet still exhibit a substantial gap from dense attention at aggressive sparsity. We introduce \emph{Stratified Sparse Attention (SSA)}, a unified framework combining deterministic retrieval with score-guided sampling. SSA deterministically attends to high-scoring tokens while sampling the residual using proxy attention scores and correcting for their inclusion probabilities, thereby recovering attention mass beyond the retrieval set. translated_title: 分层稀疏注意力：在极端稀疏度下缩小稀疏与稠密注意力之间的差距
translated_abstract: 大语言模型在长上下文上的推理日益受到注意力机制处理不断增长的键值（KV）缓存所需成本的瓶颈制约。稀疏注意力通过仅访问缓存的一部分来降低这一成本，但现有方法面临一个权衡：确定性检索能够捕获高分数的token，却会丢弃剩余的注意力质量；而采样虽然提高了覆盖率，却以更高的方差为代价。混合方法将top-k检索与均匀采样相结合，但在极端稀疏度下仍与稠密注意力存在显著差距。我们提出了分层稀疏注意力（SSA），这是一个将确定性检索与分数引导采样相结合的统一框架。SSA确定性地关注高分数的token，同时利用代理注意力分数对剩余部分进行采样，并对其被选中的概率进行校正，从而恢复检索集合之外的注意力质量。SSA涵盖……
tldr: 提出分层稀疏注意力（SSA）统一框架，将确定性检索与分数引导采样相结合，通过代理注意力分数恢复检索集合之外的注意力质量，从而在极端稀疏度下显著缩小稀疏注意力与稠密注意力之间的差距。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Stratified Sparse Attention (SSA), a unified framework combining deterministic retrieval with score-guided sampling that recovers attention mass beyond the retrieval set, substantially closing the gap between sparse and dense attention at extreme sparsity.
